_note: Characters tab content, English base. 'intro' is original devotional-style prose written for this app, not scripture text. 'verse_refs' are citations (book_id/chapter/verse_start/verse_end + a short caption) -- no verse text is stored here; the app looks up the real text live from scripture_verse for whichever translation is current, same as the Read tab. References were compiled from general knowledge of well-known passages, not copied from a concordance -- worth a spot-check pass before wide release, same caveat as the rest of this prototype's authored content. 'requires_deuterocanon' hides a character automatically for a translation whose books don't include their source book (currently just Tobit and Judith).

characters.name: Jesus Christ
characters.intro: The Son of God, whose birth, teaching, death, and resurrection are the center of the New Testament and of the Christian faith.

verse_refs.caption: "In the beginning was the Word"
Peter's confession: "You are the Christ"
"I am the resurrection and the life"

characters.name: Mary, Mother of Jesus
characters.intro: The young woman of Nazareth who said yes to becoming the mother of the Messiah, and stayed with him to the cross.

verse_refs.caption: "Let it be done to me according to your word"
The Magnificat: "My soul magnifies the Lord"
At the foot of the cross

characters.name: Joseph
characters.intro: A carpenter of Nazareth, husband of Mary and foster father of Jesus, who protected his family through dreams and hardship.

verse_refs.caption: The angel's message in a dream
The flight into Egypt

characters.name: John the Baptist
characters.intro: The prophet who called Israel to repentance and baptized Jesus in the Jordan, preparing the way for him.

verse_refs.caption: The baptism of Jesus
"Behold, the Lamb of God"

characters.name: Elizabeth
characters.intro: Mary's kinswoman, who conceived John the Baptist in her old age and greeted Mary as the mother of her Lord.

verse_refs.caption: "Blessed are you among women"

characters.name: Zechariah
characters.intro: A priest struck mute for doubting the angel's promise of a son, whose voice returned in a song of prophecy at John's birth.

verse_refs.caption: The angel's promise in the Temple
The Benedictus

characters.name: Simeon
characters.intro: A devout old man promised he would see the Messiah before he died, who took the infant Jesus in his arms in the Temple.

verse_refs.caption: The Nunc Dimittis

characters.name: Anna
characters.intro: An elderly prophetess who worshiped in the Temple night and day and recognized the infant Jesus as the redemption of Jerusalem.

verse_refs.caption: Anna's witness in the Temple

characters.name: Peter
characters.intro: A fisherman called "the rock," whose bold faith and painful failures make him the most human of the apostles, and the first leader of the Church.

verse_refs.caption: "You are Peter, and on this rock"
Walking on water, then sinking
Peter's denial and bitter weeping
"Feed my sheep"

characters.name: Andrew
characters.intro: Peter's brother and the first apostle Jesus called, who first brought Peter and a boy's loaves and fishes to Jesus.

verse_refs.caption: Andrew brings Peter to Jesus
The boy with five loaves and two fish

characters.name: John
characters.intro: "The disciple whom Jesus loved," who leaned on him at the Last Supper and later wrote a Gospel, three letters, and Revelation.

verse_refs.caption: Reclining next to Jesus at supper
Entrusted with the care of Mary

characters.name: James (son of Zebedee)
characters.intro: John's brother, one of the inner circle at the Transfiguration, and the first apostle to be martyred.

verse_refs.caption: Witness to the Transfiguration
His martyrdom under Herod

characters.name: Philip
characters.intro: An apostle from Bethsaida who brought Nathanael to Jesus and later asked to see the Father.

verse_refs.caption: "Come and see"
"Show us the Father"

characters.name: Bartholomew (Nathanael)
characters.intro: An apostle Jesus called "an Israelite in whom there is no deceit," won over by being seen under a fig tree.

verse_refs.caption: "Behold, an Israelite indeed"

characters.name: Thomas
characters.intro: The apostle remembered for doubting the Resurrection until he touched Jesus' wounds himself, then confessing him as Lord and God.

verse_refs.caption: "Unless I see... I will not believe"
"My Lord and my God"

characters.name: Matthew
characters.intro: A despised tax collector who left his booth to follow Jesus, and later wrote a Gospel presenting him as the promised Messiah.

verse_refs.caption: "Follow me," and he rose and followed

characters.name: James (son of Alphaeus)
characters.intro: One of the Twelve, sometimes called "James the Less" to distinguish him from James the son of Zebedee.

verse_refs.caption: Named among the Twelve

characters.name: Thaddaeus (Jude)
characters.intro: An apostle also called Jude, who asked Jesus at the Last Supper why he would reveal himself only to his followers.

verse_refs.caption: "Lord, how is it...?"

characters.name: Simon the Zealot
characters.intro: One of the Twelve, identified as a Zealot -- likely tied to the movement resisting Roman rule.

verse_refs.caption: Named among the Twelve

characters.name: Judas Iscariot
characters.intro: The apostle who betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver, and whose remorse ended in despair rather than repentance.

verse_refs.caption: The bargain for thirty pieces of silver
His remorse and death

characters.name: Paul
characters.intro: A zealous persecutor of Christians transformed on the road to Damascus into the Church's most tireless missionary and writer.

verse_refs.caption: Struck down on the road to Damascus
His hymn to love
"I have fought the good fight"

characters.name: Barnabas
characters.intro: "Son of encouragement," who vouched for the converted Paul and became his first missionary companion.

verse_refs.caption: Introduced as "son of encouragement"
Vouches for Paul before the apostles

characters.name: Silas
characters.intro: Paul's companion who was imprisoned and beaten with him in Philippi, and sang hymns with him in a midnight jail cell.

verse_refs.caption: Singing hymns in prison at midnight

characters.name: Timothy
characters.intro: A young disciple Paul treated as a son in the faith, entrusted with leading the church at Ephesus.

verse_refs.caption: "Let no one despise your youth"
His faith inherited from his mother and grandmother

characters.name: Titus
characters.intro: A Gentile convert and trusted delegate Paul left in Crete to organize the churches there.

verse_refs.caption: Left in Crete to set things in order

characters.name: Luke
characters.intro: A physician and Gentile convert who carefully researched and wrote a Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles.

verse_refs.caption: His preface, explaining his careful research

characters.name: Mark (John Mark)
characters.intro: A young companion of Paul and Barnabas whose early failure caused a rift, and who later wrote the earliest Gospel.

verse_refs.caption: The dispute over Mark that split Paul and Barnabas

characters.name: Stephen
characters.intro: A deacon full of grace and power, whose bold preaching led to his stoning as the Church's first martyr.

verse_refs.caption: His dying prayer for his killers

characters.name: Philip the Evangelist
characters.intro: One of the seven chosen to serve the early church, who explained the Scriptures to an Ethiopian official and baptized him.

verse_refs.caption: Explains the Scriptures to the Ethiopian eunuch

characters.name: Cornelius
characters.intro: A devout Roman centurion whose vision, and Peter's, opened the Church's mission to the Gentiles.

verse_refs.caption: "God shows no partiality"

characters.name: Priscilla and Aquila
characters.intro: A missionary couple, tentmakers by trade, who hosted a house church and taught Apollos more accurately.

verse_refs.caption: They explain the Way to Apollos more accurately

characters.name: Apollos
characters.intro: An eloquent, Scripture-versed preacher whose ministry watered what Paul had planted in Corinth.

verse_refs.caption: "I planted, Apollos watered"

characters.name: Lydia
characters.intro: A seller of purple cloth in Philippi and the first recorded convert in Europe, who opened her home to Paul's mission.

verse_refs.caption: Her heart opened to Paul's message

characters.name: James, brother of Jesus
characters.intro: A leader of the Jerusalem church who once doubted Jesus, later encountered the risen Christ, and wrote a New Testament letter.

verse_refs.caption: The risen Christ appears to James
"Count it all joy... trials produce steadfastness"

characters.name: Jude, brother of Jesus
characters.intro: A brother of Jesus and James who wrote a short, urgent letter warning against false teachers.

verse_refs.caption: "Contend for the faith"

characters.name: Philemon
characters.intro: A Christian slaveholder Paul wrote to directly, urging him to welcome back his runaway slave Onesimus as a brother.

verse_refs.caption: "No longer as a slave, but... a beloved brother"

characters.name: Onesimus
characters.intro: A runaway slave who became a Christian under Paul's care, and was sent back to his master with a plea for mercy.

verse_refs.caption: Paul's appeal on his behalf

characters.name: Mary Magdalene
characters.intro: A woman Jesus freed from great affliction, who stayed at the cross and was the first to see him risen from the dead.

verse_refs.caption: Jesus calls her by name at the tomb
"I have seen the Lord"

characters.name: Martha
characters.intro: Sister of Mary and Lazarus, distracted by hosting Jesus, and later the one who confessed him as the Christ before Lazarus rose.

verse_refs.caption: "Martha, Martha, you are anxious..."
"You are the Christ, the Son of God"

characters.name: Mary of Bethany
characters.intro: Sister of Martha and Lazarus, remembered for sitting at Jesus' feet and anointing him with costly perfume.

verse_refs.caption: Sitting at the Lord's feet, listening
Anoints Jesus' feet with costly perfume

characters.name: Lazarus
characters.intro: A friend of Jesus who died and lay four days in the tomb before Jesus called him back to life.

verse_refs.caption: "Lazarus, come out"

characters.name: Nicodemus
characters.intro: A Pharisee who came to Jesus by night with questions, and later helped bury him with dignity.

verse_refs.caption: "Rabbi, we know you are a teacher come from God"
Brings myrrh and aloes for Jesus' burial

characters.name: The Samaritan Woman
characters.intro: A woman Jesus met at a well, whose honest conversation about her life led her to become an evangelist to her whole town.

verse_refs.caption: "Come, see a man who told me all that I ever did"

characters.name: Zacchaeus
characters.intro: A wealthy, short tax collector who climbed a tree to see Jesus, and gave away half his goods after Jesus dined at his house.

verse_refs.caption: "Today salvation has come to this house"

characters.name: Bartimaeus
characters.intro: A blind beggar of Jericho whose persistent cry for mercy Jesus answered, restoring his sight.

verse_refs.caption: "Your faith has made you well"

characters.name: Joseph of Arimathea
characters.intro: A wealthy, secret disciple who asked Pilate for Jesus' body and laid him in his own new tomb.

verse_refs.caption: Wraps Jesus' body and lays it in his tomb

characters.name: Simon of Cyrene
characters.intro: A passerby forced to carry Jesus' cross, unwittingly sharing in the road to Calvary.

verse_refs.caption: Compelled to carry the cross

characters.name: Dorcas (Tabitha)
characters.intro: A disciple in Joppa known for charity to widows, whom Peter raised from the dead.

verse_refs.caption: "Tabitha, rise"

characters.name: Herod the Great
characters.intro: The paranoid king of Judea at Jesus' birth, who ordered the massacre of infant boys in Bethlehem.

verse_refs.caption: Orders the massacre of the innocents

characters.name: Herod Antipas
characters.intro: Herod the Great's son, who beheaded John the Baptist and later mocked Jesus at his trial.

verse_refs.caption: Orders John the Baptist's beheading

characters.name: Herodias
characters.intro: Herod Antipas's wife, whose grudge against John the Baptist led to his execution.

verse_refs.caption: Her grudge against John the Baptist

characters.name: Pontius Pilate
characters.intro: The Roman governor who found no guilt in Jesus, yet handed him over to be crucified.

verse_refs.caption: "I find no guilt in him"
Washes his hands of the matter

characters.name: Caiaphas
characters.intro: The high priest who presided over Jesus' trial and pressed for his death.

verse_refs.caption: "It is better... one man should die"

characters.name: Adam
characters.intro: The first man, formed from the dust and given the breath of life, whose disobedience in Eden brought sin into the world.

verse_refs.caption: Formed from dust and given breath
Eats the forbidden fruit

characters.name: Eve
characters.intro: The first woman, "the mother of all living," deceived by the serpent before Adam in the garden.

verse_refs.caption: Named "the mother of all living"

characters.name: Cain
characters.intro: Adam and Eve's firstborn, whose jealousy of his brother Abel led to history's first murder.

verse_refs.caption: Rises up and kills his brother Abel

characters.name: Abel
characters.intro: Adam and Eve's second son, a shepherd whose offering pleased God, and the first person to be murdered.

verse_refs.caption: His offering that pleased God

characters.name: Enoch
characters.intro: A man remembered for walking so closely with God that he did not experience death.

verse_refs.caption: "Enoch walked with God, and he was not"

characters.name: Noah
characters.intro: The one righteous man of his generation, who built the Ark and preserved his family and the animals through the flood.

verse_refs.caption: God's command to build the Ark
The rainbow, sign of the covenant

characters.name: Melchizedek
characters.intro: The mysterious priest-king of Salem who blessed Abraham, later seen as a foreshadowing of Christ's eternal priesthood.

verse_refs.caption: Blesses Abraham with bread and wine
A type of Christ's eternal priesthood

characters.name: Abraham
characters.intro: Called by God to leave his homeland for the promise of a new nation, the father of many nations by faith.

verse_refs.caption: God's call to leave his country
The binding of Isaac

characters.name: Sarah
characters.intro: Abraham's wife, who laughed at God's promise of a son in her old age, then bore Isaac as promised.

verse_refs.caption: Laughs at the promise of a son
"God has made laughter for me"

characters.name: Hagar
characters.intro: Sarah's servant, mother of Ishmael, twice driven into the wilderness and met there by God.

verse_refs.caption: Names God "the God who sees me"

characters.name: Isaac
characters.intro: The long-promised son of Abraham and Sarah, bound as a sacrifice on Moriah and later father of Jacob and Esau.

verse_refs.caption: "Where is the lamb for the offering?"
Marries Rebekah and is comforted

characters.name: Rebekah
characters.intro: Isaac's wife, chosen at a well for her kindness, who later favored Jacob and helped him secure the birthright blessing.

verse_refs.caption: Offers to water Abraham's servant's camels

characters.name: Jacob (Israel)
characters.intro: Isaac's son, who wrestled with God at Peniel and was renamed Israel, father of the twelve tribes.

verse_refs.caption: Renamed Israel after wrestling with God
Dreams of a ladder to heaven

characters.name: Esau
characters.intro: Jacob's twin brother, who sold his birthright for a bowl of stew and was later reconciled with him.

verse_refs.caption: Sells his birthright for bread and stew

characters.name: Rachel
characters.intro: Jacob's beloved wife, for whom he worked fourteen years, and mother of Joseph and Benjamin.

verse_refs.caption: Jacob's seven years of labor for her love

characters.name: Leah
characters.intro: Jacob's first wife, less loved than her sister Rachel, yet mother of six of the twelve tribes including Judah.

verse_refs.caption: God sees she is unloved, and opens her womb

characters.name: Joseph
characters.intro: Jacob's favored son, sold into slavery by his brothers, who rose to power in Egypt and forgave them.

verse_refs.caption: Sold into slavery by his brothers
"I am Joseph your brother"
"You meant evil... God meant it for good"

characters.name: Judah
characters.intro: Jacob's fourth son, whose tribe would give rise to David and, through him, to Jesus.

verse_refs.caption: "The scepter shall not depart from Judah"

characters.name: Moses
characters.intro: Rescued from the Nile as an infant, called from a burning bush to free Israel from Egypt and receive the Law at Sinai.

verse_refs.caption: "I AM WHO I AM" at the burning bush
Parts the Red Sea
Receives the Ten Commandments

characters.name: Aaron
characters.intro: Moses' brother and spokesman, who became Israel's first high priest.

verse_refs.caption: Appointed as Moses' spokesman

characters.name: Miriam
characters.intro: Moses' sister, a prophetess who watched over him as a baby and led Israel's women in song after the Red Sea crossing.

verse_refs.caption: Leads the women in song and dance

characters.name: Joshua
characters.intro: Moses' successor, who led Israel across the Jordan into the Promised Land and captured Jericho.

verse_refs.caption: "Be strong and courageous"
The walls of Jericho fall

characters.name: Caleb
characters.intro: One of twelve spies sent into Canaan, whose faithful report and lifelong trust in God earned him entry into the Promised Land.

verse_refs.caption: "We are well able to overcome it"

characters.name: Rahab
characters.intro: A woman of Jericho who hid Israel's spies and was spared when the city fell, later an ancestor of David.

verse_refs.caption: Hides the Israelite spies

characters.name: Deborah
characters.intro: A prophetess and judge of Israel who led the nation to victory over its oppressors.

verse_refs.caption: Judging Israel under the palm of Deborah

characters.name: Gideon
characters.intro: A hesitant farmer called to lead Israel, who defeated a vast Midianite army with just three hundred men.

verse_refs.caption: God whittles his army down to 300

characters.name: Samson
characters.intro: A judge of Israel gifted with supernatural strength through his Nazirite vow, undone by his love for Delilah.

verse_refs.caption: Reveals the secret of his strength
His final act, pulling down the temple

characters.name: Delilah
characters.intro: The woman who wheedled the secret of Samson's strength out of him and betrayed him to the Philistines.

verse_refs.caption: Has Samson's hair cut while he sleeps

characters.name: Ruth
characters.intro: A Moabite widow whose loyalty to her mother-in-law Naomi led her to become an ancestor of David.

verse_refs.caption: "Where you go, I will go"

characters.name: Naomi
characters.intro: Ruth's mother-in-law, who lost her husband and sons in Moab and returned to Bethlehem bereaved, then blessed.

verse_refs.caption: "Call me Mara, for the Almighty has dealt bitterly"

characters.name: Boaz
characters.intro: A kind and wealthy landowner who married Ruth as her kinsman-redeemer, becoming an ancestor of David.

verse_refs.caption: Marries Ruth

characters.name: Samuel
characters.intro: Given to the Lord's service as a boy, Israel's last judge and a prophet who anointed both Saul and David as king.

verse_refs.caption: "Speak, for your servant hears"
Anoints David king

characters.name: Hannah
characters.intro: Samuel's mother, who prayed years for a child and dedicated him to the Lord's service once he was born.

verse_refs.caption: "For this child I prayed"

characters.name: Saul
characters.intro: Israel's first king, tall and promising, whose disobedience and jealousy of David led to his downfall.

verse_refs.caption: Anointed as Israel's first king
"Rebellion is as the sin of divination"

characters.name: Jonathan
characters.intro: Saul's son, whose deep friendship with David survived his father's jealous rage.

verse_refs.caption: His soul knit to David's
David's lament for Jonathan

characters.name: David
characters.intro: A shepherd boy who slew Goliath and became Israel's greatest king, a man after God's own heart despite his sins.

verse_refs.caption: Faces Goliath in the name of the Lord
"The Lord is my shepherd"
"I have sinned against the Lord"

characters.name: Bathsheba
characters.intro: The woman David took as his wife after a great sin against her family, and mother of Solomon.

verse_refs.caption: Becomes David's wife
Secures the throne for her son Solomon

characters.name: Nathan
characters.intro: A court prophet who confronted King David over his sin with Bathsheba with a piercing parable.

verse_refs.caption: "You are the man!"

characters.name: Absalom
characters.intro: David's handsome, rebellious son, whose revolt against his father ended in his own death.

verse_refs.caption: David's grief: "O Absalom, my son"

characters.name: Solomon
characters.intro: David's son, who asked God for wisdom above riches, built the Temple in Jerusalem, and wrote much of the Wisdom literature.

verse_refs.caption: Asks for a discerning heart
The Temple filled with the glory of the Lord

characters.name: Elijah
characters.intro: A fierce prophet who confronted the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel and was taken up to heaven in a whirlwind.

verse_refs.caption: Fire falls from heaven on Mount Carmel
God speaks in a still, small voice
Taken up to heaven in a whirlwind

characters.name: Elisha
characters.intro: Elijah's successor, who asked for a double portion of his spirit and performed many miracles for Israel.

verse_refs.caption: Asks for a double portion of Elijah's spirit

characters.name: Ahab
characters.intro: A king of Israel who married the pagan Jezebel and led the nation into idolatry, opposed by Elijah.

verse_refs.caption: Provokes the Lord more than any king before him

characters.name: Jezebel
characters.intro: Ahab's foreign queen, who promoted Baal worship and hunted the prophets of the Lord.

verse_refs.caption: Threatens Elijah's life

characters.name: Isaiah
characters.intro: A major prophet whose vision of God's glory sent him into ministry, and whose writings foretell the coming Messiah.

verse_refs.caption: "Here am I! Send me"
"Unto us a child is born"
"He was wounded for our transgressions"

characters.name: Jeremiah
characters.intro: "The weeping prophet," called from youth to warn Judah of coming judgment while mourning for his people.

verse_refs.caption: "Before I formed you... I knew you"
"Plans for welfare and not for evil"

characters.name: Ezekiel
characters.intro: A priest-prophet among the exiles in Babylon, known for vivid visions, including a valley of dry bones brought to life.

verse_refs.caption: "I will cause breath to enter you"

characters.name: Daniel
characters.intro: A young exile in Babylon who kept faith with God through dream interpretations, court intrigue, and a night in the lions' den.

verse_refs.caption: "My God sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths"
"Our God... is able to deliver us"

characters.name: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego
characters.intro: Daniel's three companions in Babylon, thrown into a fiery furnace for refusing to worship an idol, and preserved unharmed.

verse_refs.caption: A fourth figure walks with them in the fire

characters.name: Hosea
characters.intro: A prophet whose troubled marriage became a living picture of God's faithful love for an unfaithful Israel.

verse_refs.caption: "When Israel was a child, I loved him"

characters.name: Joel
characters.intro: A prophet who called Judah to repentance after a locust plague, and foretold the outpouring of God's Spirit.

verse_refs.caption: "I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh"

characters.name: Amos
characters.intro: A shepherd called from Judah to prophesy against Israel's injustice toward the poor.

verse_refs.caption: "Let justice roll down like waters"

characters.name: Jonah
characters.intro: A reluctant prophet who fled God's call to preach to Nineveh, was swallowed by a great fish, and finally obeyed.

verse_refs.caption: Swallowed by a great fish
Nineveh repents and is spared

characters.name: Micah
characters.intro: A prophet of Judah who denounced corrupt leaders and foretold the Messiah's birth in Bethlehem.

verse_refs.caption: Foretells Bethlehem as the Messiah's birthplace
"Do justice, love kindness, walk humbly"

characters.name: Job
characters.intro: A blameless and upright man who lost everything, questioned God in his suffering, and remained faithful.

verse_refs.caption: "The Lord gave, and the Lord has taken away"
"Now my eye sees you"

characters.name: Ezra
characters.intro: A priest and scribe who led exiles back to Jerusalem and renewed the people's commitment to God's Law.

verse_refs.caption: Set his heart to study and teach the Law

characters.name: Nehemiah
characters.intro: Cupbearer to a Persian king who returned to Jerusalem and rebuilt its walls despite fierce opposition.

verse_refs.caption: The wall completed in fifty-two days

characters.name: Esther
characters.intro: A Jewish queen of Persia who risked her life to save her people from destruction.

verse_refs.caption: "For such a time as this"
"If I perish, I perish"

characters.name: Mordecai
characters.intro: Esther's cousin and guardian, who raised the alarm over a plot against the Jews and was ultimately honored by the king.

verse_refs.caption: Urges Esther to act for her people

characters.name: Tobit
characters.intro: A righteous exile in Nineveh who, despite blindness and hardship, remained devoted to charity and prayer.

verse_refs.caption: His lifelong practice of charity

characters.name: Judith
characters.intro: A brave and pious widow who saved her city by outwitting and defeating the enemy general Holofernes.

verse_refs.caption: Delivers her city from Holofernes
